_about: Benchmark stress scenarios (SCENARIOS in js/mayor.js). Each one is a patch over the default settings.

epi.name: Epidemic
epi.desc: More first cases, easier spread, fewer hospital beds

smog.name: Winter smog
smog.desc: Winter fog, 8 kilns burning all winter, heavy factory smoke

grid.name: Heat, storm and power cuts
grid.desc: Heatwave, a storm, a weak grid with frequent outages, high water use

compound.name: Compound winter crisis
compound.desc: Epidemic, smog and power cuts together in winter
